name: Funi-kun no Obenkyou 3 ~Kagai Jugyou~
original_name: フニ君のお勉強３　～課外授業～
source:
Two people go out on their first date with excitement to an amusement park. But female teacher suddenly appears and messes things up posing a rival threat. The situation is going to an unexpected direction...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两个人第一次约会兴奋地去游乐园。但女老师突然出现，搅乱了事情，构成了竞争对手的威胁。事态正朝着意想不到的方向发展……
